text: ὁ Λύκος ἔρχεται. ὁ Λύκος κακός ἐστιν.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a small gray stone that fits in one hand
a large gray boulder twice the size of Hyperbrephos
positioning: Hyperbrephos remains calm and alert, watching Lukos approach
Glaux clutches the red ball nervously, looking worried at the approaching wolf
Lukos stalks toward them with a menacing expression and predatory stance
The bright red leather ball is held by the frightened Glaux
The white leather ball lies on the ground near Hyperbrephos
The small gray stone rests within Hyperbrephos's reach
The large gray boulder looms in the background
